name: photo-gallery
blurb: Diamond-clipped photos expand to square on hover with brightness dim.
description: A masonry gallery with diamond-shaped clip-path items that transform to squares on hover. Non-hovered images dim via CSS :has() selector with focus and keyboard accessibility.
use_when: Photo galleries, portfolio showcases, or image collections with interactive hover-reveal effects.
avoid_when: When exact image aspect ratios must be preserved; clip-path distorts proportions.
a11y: Keyboard and focus accessible with visible focus outline; hover effect accessible via :has() selector.
